dimensions.assessment: Affects federal and non-federal entities participating in the conservation program across Arizona, California, and Nevada.
dimensions.evidence: cooperative effort between federal and non-federal entities in Arizona, California, and Nevada.

dimensions.assessment: Streamlines fund management and allows non-federal contributions to earn interest and be spent without further appropriation.
dimensions.evidence: Amounts deposited in the Fund... shall be made available to the Secretary, without further appropriation, for expenditure

dimensions.assessment: Handles non-federal cost-share contributions and interest investments through a newly established Treasury fund.
dimensions.evidence: interest earned on amounts in the Fund... shall be made available, subject to appropriation

dimensions.assessment: Amends Section 9402 of the Omnibus Public Land Management Act of 2009 for a specific regional conservation program.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes an interest-bearing Treasury account for non-federal contributions to the Lower Colorado River Multi-Species Conservation Program, making principal amounts available without further appropriation.
